notes.text: UNA TANTUM 2025 (Art. 71 of the CCNL 2023-2025, consolidated text of 3 November 2025, pp. 55-56): EUR 300, 200 or 100 by hire year to the workers in service on 23 July 2025, reduced for part-time, paid in three instalments with the pay of September, October and November 2025, outside every institute and the TFR. Paid in 2025: no tax year the engine computes.
CONGLOBATED (Art. 69): minimo contrattuale conglobato includes base wage, contingenza and EDR. No separate contingenza or EDR column.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS (Art. 74): tredicesima only (paid December). Art. 75 states the quattordicesima equivalent is already embedded in the monthly conglobated minimum.
SENIORITY (Art. 73): scatti triennali, max 10 scatti. Per-level amounts confirmed from Art. 73 table.
LEVEL Q ALLOWANCE (Art. 70): indennita di funzione 77.47 EUR/month paid 13 months/year.
LEVEL 1 PRE-2025: level 1 introduced ex-novo in 2025 renewal. Pre-2025 salary set equal to 2025-08-01 value (1295.43 EUR) — no historical data available.

APPRENTICESHIP (Art. 22 c. 12-15, p. 19): levels 1-5 apprentice 12 months at 90% for months 1-6 and 95% after; levels 6-10 32 months at 90% for months 1-28 and 95% after; the full pay of the qualification from the end (c. 13). The first clause of c. 12 says 'fino a 32 mesi' for levels 1-5 too, against the 12 months of c. 15: c. 15 sets the duration. Level Q, in neither list, keeps the 32-month track.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Apprendistato c. 12, p. 19 of the CCNL ANASTE, https://snalv.it/docs/anaste25/pdf6.pdf, sha256 0104ada3fe1307dce987c275b55e962e6db6230c0bc94d4182e406bb395c8c98): 'Il periodo di apprendistato è considerato utile ai fini della maturazione degli scatti di anzianità previsti dall’art. 73 del CCNL.' Reading: the scatti matured during the apprenticeship are those of art. 73 at the amounts of the level (seniority_increments.apprentice_level_amount).

Art. 70 c. 2 (p. 55): the indennità professionale of the infermieri, 155 EUR a month on 12 payments, is a fixed allowance of levels 6 and 7 with the role 'infermiere'. Absorbed by an individual pay above the CCNL: the caller states the superminimo net of the absorbed part. The TFR counts it: art. 99 does not exclude it.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 74 - Tredicesima mensilità (p. 57): "4. Le frazioni di mese pari o superiori ai 15 giorni saranno considerate come mese intero.". Match: at_least 15. The quattordicesima differs: Art. 75: no separate 14th; an equivalent amount is already included in the minimo conglobato of art. 68, so no fraction rule applies to it.

reviews.scope: Art. 69 of the CCNL ANASTE 2026-2028 signed 9 October 2026: the tabellare from 1 October 2026, 1 January 2027 and 1 January 2028 (p. 64, page image).
findings: Three tranches of the 2026-2028 renewal; the 'tabellare vigente' column equals the August 2025 values of the file.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 52 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 6 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Art. 70 c. 2 (p. 55), the declaratorie of levels 6 and 7 (p. 31), artt. 68, 74, 75 and 99 of the CCNL ANASTE 2023-2025.
findings: Art. 70 c. 2: 155 EUR a month for 12 months to the staff 'con qualifica e mansioni di infermiere', absorbable by an individual pay above the CCNL; no starting date of its own.
The infermiere is named in the declaratorie of levels 6 and 7; art. 99 does not exclude the allowance from the TFR.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

fixed_allowances.description: Indennità professionale degli infermieri (Art. 70 c. 2), with the role 'infermiere'

location.quote: Con riferimento al solo personale con qualifica e mansioni di infermiere, è riconosciuta un’indennità professionale mensile, per soli 12 mesi annui, pari ad Euro 155,00, da ritenersi assorbita ed assorbibile, fino a concorrenza, in ipotesi di eccedenza del trattamento retributivo individuale del personale interessato.

provenance.transformation: EUR 155 a month on 12 payments (not in the tredicesima of art. 74, computed on the pay of art. 68, which does not list it) with the role 'infermiere' on levels 6 and 7, the levels whose declaratoria names the infermiere (p. 31). Art. 70 states no starting date: the series starts with the CCNL of 1 January 2023. Absorbed 'fino a concorrenza' by an individual pay above the CCNL: the caller states the superminimo net of the absorbed part.

provenance.transformation: 90% for months 1-28, 95% for months 29-32, then the pay of the qualification (c. 13). Level Q is not in the lists of c. 12 and 15: it keeps this track.

location.section: Art. malattia — conservazione posto 180 giorni; integrazione al 100%

provenance.transformation: Comporto of several illnesses (2026-11-01): the comporto sums the sick days of the 36 months before the day, up to 180, on top of the 180 days of one illness. Source: https://snalv.it/docs/anaste25/pdf6.pdf, p. 52 (sha256 0104ada3fe1307dce987c275b55e962e6db6230c0bc94d4182e406bb395c8c98): 'Al lavoratore è garantita la conservazione del posto di lavoro per un periodo massimo di 180 giorni continuativi in un anno solare […] il numero di giorni di malattia risulti superiore a 180 giorni nell’arco del triennio precedente l’ultimo evento morboso.'
